create_gtn_graph: create a gtn Graph object with optional weighted flag for building finite state transducers
add_node_to_graph: add a node to a gtn graph with optional start and final state flags
add_arc_to_graph: add an arc between two nodes in a gtn graph with a symbol label
draw_gtn_graph: draw a gtn graph to a PDF file with arc and node symbol mappings
union_gtn_graphs: union multiple gtn graphs into a single combined graph
